records.name: Dunas Playa El Rebollo y Els Tossals
records.location: Les Pesqueres–El Rebollo / Els Tossals dunes and pine woodland between La Marina (Elche) and Guardamar del Segura
records.description: Large public beach, pines and dunes popular with naturists; a heavily commented cruising directory describes historic gay male meetings but site text does not supply validated recent first-person examples. Elche's 2026 municipal report describes an active monitored public beach and extensive visitor safety patrols, not sexual permission.

records.name: Centro Comercial 7 Palmas
records.location: Centro Comercial y de Ocio Siete Palmas, Av. Pintor Felo Monzón 44, 35019 Las Palmas de Gran Canaria
records.description: Commercial shopping centre referenced as a cruising spot only in a regional directory. Independent updated centre information confirms it is an operating mixed-age retail venue with family attractions, but gives no support for cruising or restroom operations. Nearby El Corte Inglés at number 46 is a different facility.
